title: Mandate Authorization Gate
description: Automated payment approval gate with no human step: a fixed ten-rule mandate check lists every failing rule with a named reason, issues a one-use authorization bound to the exact request digest with a window clipped to the mandate expiry, and re-verifies the committed request at commit time. Integer minor units, no float anywhere.

mode.description: authorize evaluates the mandate and request; verify_commit re-verifies a presented authorization.

as_of.description: Decision time as a UTC timestamp, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS ending in Z. The node reads no clock.

ttl_seconds.description: authorize only: window seconds, clipped into 1 to 900 and to the mandate expiry.

mandate.description: authorize only: the mandate drawn on; commonly the canonical pivot from art-476.

extensions.description: authorize only, optional: revoked_at, budget minor integers, allowed_rails, verified_payees.

request.description: authorize: the proposed payment. verify_commit: the request being committed, as presented.

authorization.description: verify_commit only: the authorization this node issued, presented back for commit.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: mode, as_of, ttl_seconds, mandate, extensions, request, authorization.
author: PostOakLabs

output_example.scope_note: The authorization is bound to the exact request digest and mandate digest and is single-use by design: the payment rail enforces single use through the nonce (pass authorization_id as the rail nonce, 0x-prefixed 32-byte hex), not this stateless node. Budget state is caller-supplied (spent_minor). The mandate signature is not verified here.
